title: REQ · BootScene character tests assert spawn, click, fallback and cleanup
summary: BootScene character tests fail when createCharacter or shutdown cleanup is missing.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts create (L66-L82) and createCharacter (L103-L124) spawn sprites, emit characterClick and destroy sprites on shutdown. Current tests cover spawn, interact and click. Desired behavior: tests also cover no characters, missing interact fallback and shutdown destroy. Expected result: removing that code fails a test. Why: Phaser cleanup and click wiring must be proven.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene without characters, when create runs, then add.sprite is not called
Given the SHUTDOWN callback registered via events.once, when invoked, then every character sprite destroy is called
Given a character without an interact animation, when pointerdown fires, then characterClick is emitted and no other animation plays
technical_constraints: Run with the frontend vitest config
definition_of_done: Behaviors covered by tests that fail without the code
